; Combine music/effect channel-enable masks. An effect claims selected channels; the music path fills

; Ignore zero or nonnegative requests outside 01..11; negative requests also pass the signed gate.
; Request minus one is doubled to index the word table. BIT header supplies sign/overflow, while carry

; control variant. Natural validity of negative requests remains unresolved.
; Use the active music ID to test the incoming header's replacement mask.
; Enter with X selecting effect slot $38/$66, AudioStreamLo/Hi pointing to the incoming header,
; and SoundRequest holding the incoming ID. No music, or carry permission from the mask helper,

; The helper preserves X and the stream pointer. Natural entry remains unresolved (R01-003).

; Copy header flags and stream pointer, reset interpreter cursors/sweep cache and set request identity
; in the selected effect state.
; Overflow from BIT on the incoming header selects effect cancellation versus music reset. Carry
; selecting this path survived the doubled request index; it is not a header bit.
; Select the other effect slot, optionally clear the old one, reset noise and store the new active
; effect slot.
; If carry from request-index doubling is set, stop music. Otherwise copy three stream pointers from
; the header, clear per-channel cursors/countdowns and enable their state.
; Clear active music request and state latch.
; A is current request ID. Select one bit in the incoming header's priority mask; carry reports
; whether replacement is permitted.

; High-bit tokens use the command dispatcher. Each handler returns consumed-byte count in Y;
